summary: The color regions and grip are coherent, but the exported panel is opaque and cannot be approved as the reference clear shield. Inspection confirms the saved graph sets texture_alpha_mode=OPAQUE and its postprocessor forces opacity to 1, so another sample under the same settings would not fix the material mode. Preserve geometry/texture and route to an explicit per-panel transparency correction without changing global settings.

issues.problem: Configured opaque export prevents seeing the grip through the panel; a local material correction is required before acceptance.
